title: Passenger Tweet on Security Alert

fields.avatarBrief: man in blue jacket, tired eyes, holding phone
fields.text: So, I overheard a security team member say 'something might happen at noon' and I'm scared. Is NCIA okay? #NCIA #AirportSafety
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a terminal hallway with a nervous-looking passenger looking at a phone, background shows a flight info board with a delayed flight
fields.attachedImageAlt: Passenger holding phone, looking anxious in terminal hallway

instructorNote: This is a social media misinformation inject. The PIO must decide how to respond to a rapidly spreading rumor based on a misheard phrase. Watch for attempts to downplay or overreact.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A handheld phone photo taken from behind a man in a blue jacket, face partially obscured. He stands in a terminal hallway near Gate A1, looking anxious. The phone. The background. The terminal has plain glass walls, unbranded , and muted fluorescent lighting. The camera angle is slightly tilted, lens wide, with flash glare on. A few passengers walk in blurred motion behind him. Time of day: midday. Mood: tense, private, urgent. Setting: inside a dim airport terminal concourse: crowds waiting at check-in counters, luggage carts, high ceilings, large windows
